reason: At $24.99 it is close enough to what I pay now, and the named lab report for my batch plus the money-back guarantee with nothing to ship back lowers the risk. I would try one box only because of the launch price.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and the launch price ends on January 15. I would not pay full price when I can compare per day and wait for a coupon.
would_change_my_mind: A coupon or flash sale bringing the regular price to about $24 would make me reorder instead of going back to my usual brand.
